test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which is the first Indian mosque ?
solution:
The correct answer is **Cheraman Juma Mosque**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the **Indian state of Kerala**, there is a **mosque called the Cheraman Juma Mosque at Methala, Kodungallur, and Thrissur.**
 
• According to a narrative, it was constructed in **629 CE**, making it the earliest convert **mosque **currently in operation on the** Indian subcontinent.**
 
• The successor of **Cheraman Perumal,** the Chera ruler of contemporary **Kerala**, gave the order for its construction.
 
• The **mosque's Kerala-style** construction and hanging lamps strengthen the historicity of its dating claims.
 
• The narrative of the** Cheraman Perumal Mosque** claims that **Cheraman Perumal** saw the splitting of the moon, a paranormal occurrence recounted in the **Quran **as a miracle done by **Muhammad** in response to the Meccans' request for a miracle.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A **mosque in Kilakarai, Tamil Nadu, India is called Palaiya Jumma Palli** or Meen kadai Palli. It was constructed between** 628 and 630 AD,** making it, together with** Cheraman Juma Masjid in Kodungallur, Kerala,** one of the world's oldest mosques.
 
• In the** Indian state of Uttar Pradesh's Budaun district, Kakrala** city is home to the mosque and madrasah (private school) known as **Ziarat Shareef**. **Shah Saqlain Miyan** planned and erected the structure.
 
• The **second-oldest mosque in India** is called **Malik Dinar Mosque**, and it is located in **Thalangara**, a town in **Kerala state.**
